mapper.select: SELECT w.original_storage_provider AS storageProvider, w.original_bucket AS bucket, w.original_object_key AS objectKey, w.original_object_version_id AS objectVersionId, w.original_file_extension AS fileExtension, w.original_size_bytes AS sizeBytes, w.original_sha256 AS sha256, w.original_status AS status FROM entitlements e JOIN wallpapers w ON w.id = e.wallpaper_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.wallpaper_id = #{wallpaperId}
